text:
han: Quick report  I noticed the API reference still shows a JSON body example as the primary sample for POST /v1/uploads. In practice our service requires multipart/form-data for binary files and returns an `artifact_id` + `name` in the response. I put up PR #3721 to swap the canonical example and add a short browser/node snippet.

vela: thanks for catching this. I hit a 415 when testing the JSON curl example yesterday. Good to make multipart the main sample.

doc-bot: PR #3721 by han: docs: make multipart/form-data canonical for /v1/uploads; add curl + TS FormData snippets; add OpenAPI entry for multipart; add migration note for `artifact_id`. (https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3721) :page_with_curl:

sam: suggested canonical curl: ```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/uploads" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY" \
  -F "file=@./sample.png" \
  -F "purpose=vector_index"
```
Keep a short JSON example only for the "remote URL" flow: { \"url\": \"https://example.com/file.pdf\", \"purpose\": \"document_ingest\" } with a note that JSON is only for server-side fetches.

alana: For the TS snippet (browser): ```ts
const form = new FormData();
form.append('file', fileInput.files[0]);
form.append('purpose', 'vector_index');
const res = await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/uploads', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY}` },
  body: form,
});
const d = await res.json();
console.log(d.artifact_id, d.name);
```
Add explicit note: "Do not set Content-Type header manually when using FormData in browsers (the boundary is added automatically)."

vela: OpenAPI change needed: add `multipart/form-data` under `requestBody.content` with schema: `type: object`, properties: `file: { type: string, format: binary }`, `purpose: { type: string }`. Keep `application/json` for the URL-only shape. I'll take the OpenAPI edit and run validation.

doc-bot: checklist for PR #3721: markdown snippets added, openapi pending (vela), changelog entry pending (han), docs smoke test pending (sam).

han: added changelog line at top of page: "2026-04-01: canonical uploads example changed to multipart/form-data; response field `file_id` renamed to `artifact_id`. Update client code accordingly." Also added a tiny acceptance test note: run the curl sample against local dev and assert 2xx and presence of `artifact_id` in the JSON.

vela: patched OpenAPI, validated with openapi-cli -> clean. Also added an example object for the multipart case so Swagger UI shows fields clearly.

sam: ran the acceptance smoke check locally, curl returned 200 and `artifact_id` present. LGTM.

doc-bot: PR #3721 CI: docs build + lint + openapi validate -> green.

han: merged and pushed SDK migration note in docs/sdk/migration.md: "Replace `file_id` references with `artifact_id` for uploads; treat `artifact_id` as opaque string." Thanks all. Closing thread.
